paras.en: i. The nature of the reactants

During a chemical reaction chemical bonds are broken and new bonds are[scan obscured] formed. The nature (or type) and number of these bonds and their strength play[scan obscured] a critical role in the rate of reaction. Ionic compounds react faster than covale[scan obscured] compounds as in the aqueous medium ions are only exchanged which were[scan obscured] already separated (dissociated) in aqueous solution, e.g.
